headline: Knee- to waist-high on a prime angle — glassy dawn or skip it.
today: Prime SE angle but barely a foot and a half of it, so this is a dawn log-only affair while the wind's lightest. Cross to cross-off the rest of the day keeps it clean but it won't grow. Rockaway does the same thing closer to home — no reason to make the drive.

daysToWatch.note: Small but good ESE angle with offshore wind all day and glassy evening. Log it if you're local.
Size shows up but 19-23mph wind wrecks it. Pass.
